fact_check_log.claim: Intro and area framing: four areas, over 1,000 km of coastline, east/centre/west grouping, Venetian harbour, Fortezza, Mirabello Bay, Spinalonga

Elounda Beach: sister resort Elounda Bay Palace, villas and suites with decks and pools, private chapel, package with consultant, licence paperwork, civil or religious ceremony, escorted registration transfer
Elounda Beach banquet capacities Artemis 180/430, Dionysos 100/300, Blue Lagoon 70/120, Aretoussa 300/500; lyre, fireworks, limo extras
Elounda Peninsula: gateway to east Crete, Plaka, Spinalonga, yachts; locations with advance notice; one events team across three hotels; planning services
Elounda Peninsula civil, Greek Orthodox, symbolic packages; symbolic not legally recognised in Greece

Elounda Peninsula civil package: municipal licence paperwork, two witnesses, Registry Office round trip; documents emailed 4 weeks and couriered 3 weeks before; registration at the Registry Office in Aghios Nikolaos within 40 days (stated as the venue's statement, matches source)
Elounda Peninsula packages need a three-night stay in a group hotel

Porto Elounda and Elounda Mare ceremony types 'civil, Greek Orthodox, symbolic (shared packages)': both weddings pages link the shared Elounda Collection package details; qualified as shared, accepted
Porto Elounda: Mirabello Bay shore, services, Elies under olive grove, 74 new suites 2025, 2026 works, largest seafront pool claim attributed to resort
Elounda Mare: Relais & Chateaux, rooms, bungalows, Minoan Royalty villas, four-bedroom Minoan Palace villa with beach access; shared Blue Flag beaches and restaurants
Elounda intro 'largest banquet spaces on the island'
St. Nicolas Bay: five-star, Thessi Nissi, about one mile from Agios Nikolaos, beachside chapel deck, receptions, extras on request, honeymoon suite upgrade, no capacity published

Minos Beach Art Hotel: weddings and vow renewals, waterfront bungalows and villas, two beaches, about 2 km coastline, 60+ years, 55+ Mamidakis works, Cretan nights, 50 min HER and 180 min CHQ, transfers
Minos Palace: adults-only, Lasithi, weddings and vow renewals, peninsula, cove, infinity pool, Waterfall Suite, 50 min HER, 180 min CHQ, April to November weather, 20 to 27 C

Nana Princess: Chersonissos, civil on beach, Orthodox in Chapel of St. George, symbolic, vow renewals, small to medium events; Eternal Blue, Meat-In-Point up to 120, Conference Hall, chosen-venue exclusive use; coordinator and three packages
Nana Princess ceremony time table and 35 C
Abaton: team and options, nine venues and capacities, 20 guest minimum, 300 maximum, 10 rooms for 2 nights, 152 rooms and villas, 71 private pools, 2025-2026 brochure

Amirandes: VIP Beach or chapel, VIP Beach up to 80, up to 300 across venues, Events Patio 20 to 160, 204 accommodations breakdown, 18 km from HER, near Knossos, Minoan design, 960 m2 pool, 58 private pools, Picasso ceramics
Amirandes 'easiest arrival on this list'
Out of the Blue: peninsula by Agia Pelagia, events team, three collections, Aghios Athanasios Chapel, Emelia's Secret Garden, Plateau Safran lawn, restaurants for ceremonies
Out of the Blue 'clifftop lawn' (table) and 'open sea on three sides'

Caramel: Adelianos Kampos, minutes from Rethymno, golden-sand beach, caretta caretta, retro glamour, 700 m2 seawater pool; informal weddings and vow packages most popular, no paperwork for these; no legal option published

Avra Imperial: five-star, Kolymvari beach, Rodopou views, chapel of Saint Paul, events team, Maistro hall up to 680, 1,500 m2 glass pool alfresco space, Executive Chef menus, stay and spa (spa brand correctly omitted)

Euphoria: five-star family beach resort, Kolymvari, 65,000 m2, 344 rooms, 70-key Signature Collection, pool and spa areas; informal wedding or vow renewal, witnesses, hotel representative, certificate of informal marriage; packages for up to 10, 20 or 30; extras

Sea View by En Kipo: Chania hilltop garden, own florists, 120 ceremony and reception, 4,200 m2, dance floor, dressing room, accessible WC, generator, own caterer and suppliers, works with planners, no rooms, accommodation help, airport and port access
Sea View exclusive use 10am to midnight; 'finish time beyond midnight not published' contradicted by published 2am extension
West range 'to a hilltop garden for 120' (area section and FAQ) omits Euphoria's packages for up to 30; FAQ 'largest resorts' in the east
Chania Airport CHQ name, direct bus, taxi, 24-hour parking (operator name correctly omitted)
EES fingerprints and photo, free, no action before arrival, border delays; island traffic, licensed taxis, pre-arranged pick-ups
